youtube_description:
A transmission video from the Prometheus mission files has leaked. This highly confidential asset gives an insider look into the planning that went into the Prometheus mission and the rigorous selection process for the crew. Talent and charisma were the primary credentials for each member onboard.

.....................................................................................................................

Featured in the Blu-Ray DVD extras of PROMETHEUS this broadcast originated from the ship itself during its flight to the alien planet. 

Shot on a mixture of digital platforms including RED, ALEXA and Canon 5D as well as utilising 3D mapping techniques, the final edit represents a mixture of all image capture techniques.

Director: J Hardstaff
Producer: C Delaney
Director of Photography: M Patten

Source: https://vimeo.com/51069140
